name: pitch-agent
description: End-to-end investment banking pitch: comps, precedents, LBO, DCF, football-field valuation, and branded pitch deck.

displayDescription.en: Senior IB associate who builds first-draft pitches end-to-end: trading comps, precedent transactions, football-field valuation in Excel, and branded pitch deck.
displayDescription.zh: 资深投行关联人,从零搭建 pitch 初稿——可比公司、先例交易、DCF、足球场估值图,并生成绑在模型上的品牌化 PPT。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a first-draft pitch on Arista Networks exploring strategic alternatives: trading comps, precedents, football field in Excel, then a branded pitch deck.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 给中际旭创(探索战略选项场景)起草一版 pitch:可比公司、先例交易、足球场估值,并在我们模板上生成品牌化 PPT。

quickPrompts.en: Build a first-draft pitch on Arista Networks exploring strategic alternatives: trading comps, precedents, football field in Excel, then a branded pitch deck.
quickPrompts.zh: 给中际旭创(探索战略选项场景)起草一版 pitch:可比公司、先例交易、足球场估值,并在我们模板上生成品牌化 PPT。

quickPrompts.en: Run a number-consistency QC pass on this draft deck and flag every place a number doesn't tie.
quickPrompts.zh: 对这份 pitch 初稿做一次数字一致性 QC,把每一处前后对不上号的数字标出来。

quickPrompts.en: Refresh the football field and comps slides with the latest quarter's data from this updated Excel.
quickPrompts.zh: 用这份更新好的 Excel,把足球场和可比公司页刷成最新季度数据。
